titulo: Shaun the Sheep hailed on latest list of storm names
cuerpo: Meteorologists release list of monikers for potential storms this season after 40,000 suggestions from public From a five-year-old weather enthusiast to a beloved animated sheep, the inspiration for the list of storm names for this autumn and winter is wide and varied. Austen, Boelo and Chloe will be the first named storms of this winter, meteorologists have revealed, after more than 40,000 suggestions were submitted by the public.
